Raj (EM, UK launch): Hey @Emma — quick q about PTO proration for the new London office. We hired 3 folks mid-pay-period and need to align their accruals with UK public holidays and our US blackout week for product launch. Do we do pro-rated accruals or allow a one-time carryover?
Emma (People Ops): Congrats on the launch! For mid-period hires we pro-rate based on start date per policy. But launch week exceptions can be requested if coverage is impossible. Can you share dates and roles? :celebrate:
Raj (EM, UK launch): Launch week = 2027-06-14 to 2027-06-20. New hires start 2027-06-10, 2027-06-15, 2027-06-16. Some are on rotating shifts that include the UK bank holiday on 2027-06-17.
Ava (Team Lead): Also have two engineers on oncall that week who planned time off earlier — would break coverage. We were hoping for a temporary swap + carryover for those days.
Sophie (Hiring Ops): Heads up — the contractor-to-perm conversions are effective 2027-06-12, so accruals need treating like new hires that join on that date.
Emma (People Ops): Okay. Policy snippet: "Full-time employees accrue X hours/month; partial-month hires accrue = (days employed in month / total days in month) * monthly accrual." Link: https://intranet.redwood/policies/pto-accruals
Leo (Payroll): FYI payroll computes proration with payroll cycle dates. Quick formula I use: 
```
prorated_accrual = monthly_accrual * (days_active_in_month / days_in_month)
```
We also need the employees' official start dates in Workday to compute tax/reporting.
oncall-bot: calendar invite created: "UK launch coverage rota" — 2027-06-14 — 2027-06-20 — attendees: Raj, Ava, Emma
Raj (EM, UK launch): Thanks. If we submit a formal exception request, can People Ops approve a one-time carryover for those affected staff? We want them to take the accrued days later in Q3.
Emma (People Ops): We can approve a one-time, limited carryover for launch-critical exceptions, subject to manager sign-off and confirmation that business continuity would be impacted. Please open a request with: list of employees, start dates, requested carryover days, and manager approvers. Use this template: https://intranet.redwood/requests/pto-exception-template
Ava (Team Lead): I'll assemble the list tonight and cc managers. Quick Q — do bank holidays in UK reduce accruals?
Emma (People Ops): No — public holidays don't reduce accruals. They count as paid company holidays. Only unpaid leaves affect accruals.
Sophie (Hiring Ops): Noted. I'll update new hire start dates in the spreadsheet and tag Payroll.
Leo (Payroll): Once you submit, give us 2 business days to confirm proration numbers and tax implications. If anyone needs an interim manual adjustment, flag the employee IDs.
Raj (EM, UK launch): Great. I'll file the exception by EOD with the rota and manager sign-offs. Appreciate quick turnaround. :pray:
Emma (People Ops): Thanks — we'll triage and aim to approve before payroll cutoff. If approved, carryover will be limited to the launch week days and must be used by 2027-09-30.
Ava (Team Lead): Perfect, thanks all.
Emma (People Ops): Also ping me in DM if you want me to draft the request.
